description: This Java class defines the LoanCharge entity in the Fineract project, representing charges associated with a loan, including methods for managing charge states, calculations, and relationships with installments and payments.

classes.name: LoanCharge
classes.description: Entity representing a loan charge, including details, status, relationships, and methods for managing charge lifecycle and calculations.

methods.name: markAsFullyPaid
methods.description: Marks the charge as fully paid by setting amountPaid to total amount and updating status flags.

methods.name: isFullyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge has been fully paid.

methods.name: resetToOriginal
methods.description: Resets the charge to its original state, clearing paid, waived, and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: resetPaidAmount
methods.description: Resets the paid amount and outstanding balance.

methods.name: waive
methods.description: Waives the charge or installment fee, adjusting amounts and status accordingly.

methods.name: undoWaive
methods.description: Reverses a waive action on the charge.

methods.name: calculateAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates the outstanding amount considering paid, waived, and written-off amounts.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the associated loan reference.

methods.name: isDueAtDisbursement
methods.description: Checks if the charge is due at disbursement or tranche disbursement.

methods.name: isSpecifiedDueDate
methods.description: Checks if the charge has a specified due date.

methods.name: isInstalmentFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an installment fee.

methods.name: isOverdueInstallmentCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an overdue installment.

methods.name: determineIfFullyPaid
methods.description: Determines if the charge is fully paid based on outstanding amount.

methods.name: calculateOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates the total outstanding amount including paid, waived, and written-off.

methods.name: percentageOf
methods.description: Calculates a percentage of a value based on the charge's percentage rate.

methods.name: minimumAndMaximumCap
methods.description: Applies min/max caps to a percentage amount based on charge settings.

methods.name: amount
methods.description: Returns the total amount of the charge.

methods.name: amountOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the current outstanding amount.

methods.name: hasLoanIdentifiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the loan associated matches a given ID.

methods.name: hasNotLoanIdentifiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the loan associated does not match a given ID.

methods.name: isDueInPeriod
methods.description: Checks if the charge's due date falls within a specified period.

methods.name: isFeeCharge
methods.description: Determines if the charge is a fee (not penalty).

methods.name: isPenaltyCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge is a penalty.

methods.name: isNotFullyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge is not fully paid.

methods.name: isChargePending
methods.description: Checks if the charge is pending payment.

methods.name: isPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge is marked as paid.

methods.name: isWaived
methods.description: Checks if the charge has been waived.

methods.name: isPaidOrPartiallyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge is paid or partially paid.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount as Money object.

methods.name: getAmountPaid
methods.description: Returns the paid amount as Money object.

methods.name: getAmountWaived
methods.description: Returns the waived amount as Money object.

methods.name: getAmountWrittenOff
methods.description: Returns the written-off amount as Money object.

methods.name: updatePaidAmountBy
methods.description: Updates the paid amount by a specified increment, considering installment and charge type.

methods.name: getUnpaidInstallmentLoanCharge
methods.description: Retrieves the earliest unpaid installment charge.

methods.name: getInstallmentLoanCharge
methods.description: Retrieves an installment charge by due date or installment number.

methods.name: setInstallmentLoanCharge
methods.description: Sets or replaces an installment charge for a specific installment number.

methods.name: clearLoanInstallmentCharges
methods.description: Clears all installment charges.

methods.name: installmentCharges
methods.description: Returns the set of installment charges.

methods.name: fetchRepaymentInstallment
methods.description: Fetches details of repayment installments for the charge.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the charge is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the charge.

methods.name: amountOrPercentage
methods.description: Returns the amount or percentage value.

methods.name: chargeAmount
methods.description: Calculates total charge amount including outstanding, paid, waived, and written-off.

methods.name: updateOverdueInstallmentCharge
methods.description: Updates the overdue installment charge reference.

methods.name: updateLoanTrancheDisbursementCharge
methods.description: Updates the tranche disbursement charge reference.

methods.name: updateWaivedAmount
methods.description: Updates the waived amount based on current state and currency.

methods.name: getTrancheDisbursementCharge
methods.description: Returns the tranche disbursement charge.

methods.name: undoPaidOrPartiallyAmountBy
methods.description: Reverses a payment or partial payment on the charge.

methods.name: getLastPaidOrPartiallyPaidInstallmentLoanCharge
methods.description: Retrieves the last installment charge that was paid or partially paid.

methods.name: isDisbursementCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge is a disbursement charge.

methods.name: isTrancheDisbursementCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge is a tranche disbursement.

methods.name: isDueDateCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge has a due date.

methods.name: undoWaived
methods.description: Reverses the waived status.

methods.name: getChargeTimeType
methods.description: Returns the charge time type enum.

methods.name: getEffectiveDueDate
methods.description: Returns the effective due date, considering installment fees.

methods.name: getLoanChargePaidBy
methods.description: Returns the list of LoanChargePaidBy filtered by a predicate.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the entity to a data transfer object.

methods.name: hasInstallmentFor
methods.description: Checks if an installment is associated with this charge.
